{
 "title": "Implement and verify diagonal-stripe transform",
 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-f937d880.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Extend the periodic monochrome stripe pattern visible in the grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    directions = [
        lambda r, c: r,       # horizontal stripes
        lambda r, c: c,       # vertical stripes
        lambda r, c: c - r,   # NW-SE diagonals
        lambda r, c: c + r,   # NE-SW diagonals
    ]
    candidates = []
    for direction in directions:
        groups = {}
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color:
                    groups.setdefault(direction(r, c), {}).setdefault(color, 0)
                    groups[direction(r, c)][color] += 1
        # Every observed stripe must be monochromatic.
        if not groups or any(len(colors) != 1 for colors in groups.values()):
            continue
        stripe_colors = {k: next(iter(colors)) for k, colors in groups.items()}
        period = None
        for p in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
            residues = {}
            good = True
            for k, color in stripe_colors.items():
                residue = k % p
                if residue in residues and residues[residue] != color:
                    good = False
                    break
                residues[residue] = color
            if good:
                period = p
                break
        if period is not None:
            quality = sum(sum(colors.values()) ** 2 for colors in groups.values())
            candidates.append((quality, period, direction, stripe_colors))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, period, direction, stripe_colors = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])
    residue_colors = {}
    for k, color in stripe_colors.items():
        residue_colors[k % period] = color
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = residue_colors.get(direction(r, c) % period)
            if color is not None:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
PY
